name: Puddles!
description: Shaken, not... spilled? Adds puddles to several thrown items. Water and wine (electricity), vodka (flammable) and soda (slippery).

options.name: Water
options.tooltip: Water pools from Atlantide bottle, martini shaker, and snow globe

options.name: Vodka
options.tooltip: Throwing the vodka bottle creates a flammable pool of vodka

options.name: Wine
options.tooltip: Throwing wine bottles creates pools of wine that can electrocute like water

options.name: Soda
options.tooltip: Throwing soda cans creates slippery puddles of soda

options.name: Unlockables
options.tooltip: Adds Atlantide water bottle, soda can and vodka bottles to loadout screen
